name: S-NARE -Semadori-yakata Tsuisouroku-
source:
It is called the Semadori-yakata.
An estate mansion located in the middle of nowhere, with a dark past.
No... it once was.
The mansion no longer exists.

Sora Tochika is a freelance writer who specializes in obscure,
backwood stories like this. She finds her way to the site where the
mansion used to be.

It seems like it would make a great article.

And there... there where nothing should be...
the Semadori-yakata beckons.

Like a dream.

And one step beyond its doors... 

[from [url=http://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE101270.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
它被称为濑取馆。一座坐落在荒郊野外、有着黑暗过去的宅邸。不……曾经是。这座宅邸已经不复存在了。十束空是一位专门报道这种偏僻、冷门故事的自由撰稿人。她找到了宅邸曾经所在的遗址。这似乎会是一篇很棒的文章。而在那里……那里本不该有任何东西……濑取馆在召唤着。如同一场梦。而当你踏入它的大门一步……
